//: Not an npm package and never installed. This file exists solely so Node treats the ESM .js files in this directory as modules: node <22.7 does not sniff module syntax, so `import { framed } from './protocol.js'` otherwise fails with "is a CommonJS module". Browsers ignore it — they go by the <script type="module"> tag. Renaming the files to .mjs would work for node but risks the static file server handing browsers the wrong Content-Type.
name: beamdrop-webui-static
